mode: Original Handlebars templates + simulated Foundry helpers/prepared contexts + DOM adapter; NOT live Foundry
protectedInvariants: native FormData entries unchanged (when jsdom available)
all control values/explicit option values and selected/checked/disabled states unchanged
all non-ARIA attributes, including data-* and placeholders, unchanged except exact whitelisted characteristic-chip data-tooltip values
whitelisted characteristic-chip tooltips independently equal native Russian characteristic names; all data-step-* values remain unchanged
Actor/Item names and catalog/datalist names unchanged
rich description/editor/textarea HTML unchanged, including colliding UI class names inside description HTML
entire prepared context and mock Document JSON unchanged
DOM element identities and hierarchy unchanged

helpersSimulated.localize: Merged native Russian dictionary with original English fallback and named {placeholder} formatting.
helpersSimulated.selectOptions: Escaped explicit value attributes; selected values retained; optional localize=true and blank choice.
helpersSimulated.checked: SafeString Boolean checked attribute; actual checked property is asserted.
helpersSimulated.dh2eChips: DISPLAY-ONLY identity labels for fixture tokens; no catalog loading, parser, picker writes, UUID resolution or system formatter execution.

limitations: Prepared data is constructed to match the audited system context shape; _prepareContext and game documents are not executed.

No Foundry startup, ApplicationV2 lifecycle, ProseMirror custom-element form participation, permissions, submit handlers, derived rules, picker writes, canvas, CSS geometry or browser layout is exercised.
Known risk around translated weapon quality names and canonical picker serialization is outside this DOM-only test; see item-ui.urgent-adapter-note.json and parent core adapter verification.
English item/actor/catalog names, descriptions, formula aliases, range syntax and custom homebrew options are intentional data preservation, not localization gaps.
